levels.name: Gångbron
levels.note: Footbridge linking the station building and the platforms (Trafikverket); Jernhusen gives it its own opening hours under the heading 'Gångbron'.
levels._source: Jernhusen, https://www.jernhusen.se/hitta-din-station/vasteras-centralstation/, read 2026-10-30; Trafikverket, "Järnvägsplan, Samrådsunderlag Västerås C och uppställning för persontåg" (2013-06-26), p. 29 and 32, https://bransch.trafikverket.se/contentassets/25a82234af99408caf42dff71a6b94b7/samradsunderlag_vasterasc_del1.pdf, read 2026-10-30

connections.where: at the station-building end of the footbridge, by platform 1
under the footbridge on the 2/3 platform
under the footbridge on the 4/5 platform
two ramps/flights down from the footbridge to the 2/3 platform
connections.note: OSM classes these as ramps (level 0;1); no source says whether they are sloped ramps or stairs. Trafikverket (2013) calls the footbridge connections down to the platforms cramped.
connections._source: OSM (osmfacts/740000099.json, ODbL), read 2026-10-30; Trafikverket, "Järnvägsplan, Samrådsunderlag Västerås C och uppställning för persontåg" (2013-06-26), p. 29 and 32, https://bransch.trafikverket.se/contentassets/25a82234af99408caf42dff71a6b94b7/samradsunderlag_vasterasc_del1.pdf, read 2026-10-30

connections.where: two ramps/flights down from the footbridge to the 4/5 platform
connections.note: As above: OSM 'ramp', not confirmed by a plan.

entrances.name: Front entrance (towards the ring road)
entrances.where: front of the station building; has steps, not step-free
entrances.note: Jernhusen: 'entrén från framsidan mot ringvägen är inte tillgänglig (trappa)'. OSM entrances n9490281775/n9490281777 are on this side.

entrances.name: Side entrances
entrances.where: on the sides of the station building; step-free
entrances.note: Jernhusen: 'Entréer från stationens sidor ... är tillgängliga'. OSM n9490281776 (wheelchair=yes, sliding door).

plans.title: Hållplatslägen Västerås Central (temporary map 2026, last updated 2026-03-06)
plans.note: Linked from Jernhusen. Text shows bus stops and the two temporary coach/replacement stops by track 1B; no lifts or stairs in the text.

open: Platform layout is from Trafikverket's 2013 document (track 1 platform; islands 2/3 and 4/5); OSM splits them into 1a/1b, 2a/2b, 3a/3b, 4a/4b, 5. No newer owner text checked.
All footbridge lifts, the escalator and the ramps are OSM only: no plan or owner text lists them. Whether OSM's 'ramps' are ramps or stairs is unconfirmed.
Which floor/side of the station building Espresso House, Pressbyrån, toilets and lockers are on: no plan found.
Shop hours for Espresso House and Pressbyrån from their own websites (not readable); OSM hours used instead.
Heights of Gångbron and street level: no source measures them.
Bus terminal is under reconstruction in 2026 (temporary VL map); stop positions may change.
